phase: fourth TAP research layer — governance resolution only (which documented authority governs)
inputs: Situation (explicit governance context passed as application metadata)
responsibility: resolve WHICH documented authority (rule/policy/regulation/contract/version) governs a situation, and why; NOT factual/claim truth, a user answer, retrieval, relationship discovery, or execution authorization
honesty_notes: New, independently authored synthetic corpus; no upstream gold is reused as governance gold.
Deterministic, documented-rule resolution over already-perfect synthetic relationship inputs (upstream confidence 1.0); this phase evaluates the governance layer, not upstream extraction.
Results are mechanism/construction validation on the synthetic corpus used in this study only.
The eval split is content-hash locked and preregistered, but was inspected during iterative engineering — a LOCKED DEVELOPMENT evaluation, not an untouched or interpreter-blind holdout.
No claim of production legal/regulatory reasoning; the authority hierarchy and precedence rules are a documented, frozen model, not law.

baselines.A: first matching policy (no applicability filtering, no selectability guard)
baselines.F: full Governance Truth (+ conflict detection, confidence, gaps, provenance, trace)

config_selection_rule: the SIMPLEST baseline (A..F order) that satisfies ALL preregistered gates on the DEV split; the locked eval split is never used for selection.

verdict_rule.PASS_WITH_LIMITED_CLAIM: all gates pass on the locked eval for the selected baseline (capped by synthetic corpus + documented rule model)
verdict_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: no baseline passes all gates on dev, or 1-2 non-severe gates fail on eval
verdict_rule.FAIL: a severe gate fails or 3+ gates fail on eval
